items.exampleEn: The two houses are ten meters apart.
items.exampleZh: 這兩棟房子相隔十公尺。

items.exampleEn: Shall we go for a walk?
This shop is too expensive. Let's look elsewhere.
items.exampleZh: 這家店太貴了，我們去別的地方看看吧。

items.exampleEn: Please turn round so I can see your back.
items.exampleZh: 請轉過身來，讓我看看你的背。

items.exampleEn: I have a cat and a dog. The latter is very big.
items.exampleZh: 我養了一隻貓和一隻狗，後者體型很大。

items.exampleEn: I mainly use my phone for music.
This coat is too big. Besides, I don't like the color.
items.exampleZh: 這件外套太大了。而且，我也不喜歡這個顏色。

items.exampleEn: The shop is open till ten tonight.
items.exampleZh: 那家店今晚營業到十點。

items.sentenceEn: Shall we meet at the station at nine?
items.sentenceZh: 我們九點在車站見面好嗎？

items.audioEn: I'll be at work till six, so let's have dinner at seven.
items.audioZh: 我會工作到六點，所以我們七點吃晚餐吧。

items.sentenceEn: When I called her name, she looked round.
items.sentenceZh: 我叫她名字的時候，她回過頭來。

items.sentenceEn: Our birthdays are only two days apart.

items.stemEn: This cafe is full. Let's go ____.
items.stemZh: 這家咖啡店客滿了，我們去別的地方吧。
我們可以在這裡待到星期天。

items.passageEn: Ben and his younger sister Sara live far apart. Ben lives in Taipei, and Sara lives in Tainan. Last week, Sara called him. "Shall I visit you, or will you come here?" Ben chose the latter, so he took the train to Tainan. He stayed there till Monday. They mainly ate good food and talked. "Next time, you come to Taipei," he said.
items.passageZh: Ben 和他的妹妹 Sara 住得相隔很遠。Ben 住在台北，Sara 住在台南。上週 Sara 打電話給他：「我去看你，還是你來這裡？」Ben 選了後者，所以他搭火車去台南。他在那裡待到星期一。他們主要就是吃好吃的東西、聊天。他說：「下次換妳來台北。」

questions.questionZh: Ben 在台南待到星期幾？

items.promptZh: 我不想去那家餐廳。而且，它太遠了。
referenceEn: I don't want to go to that restaurant. Besides, it's too far.
I don't want to go to that restaurant. Besides, it is too far away.
rubricZh: 「而且」用 Besides 放在第二句句首，表示補充另一個理由
「太遠」可寫例如 too far、too far away
「不想去」可寫例如 don't want to go、don't feel like going

items.instructionZh: 用 Shall we 造一個句子，邀請朋友一起做某件事。
referenceEn: Shall we go to the movies tonight?
rubricZh: Shall we 後面接原形動詞（例如 Shall we go、Shall we have）
這是提議的問句，句尾用問號
